problem: The Execution Plane push gate proves durable effect/delivery correctness but does not yet explicitly exercise the breadth of native product task types required for productization: filesystem, shell/process cancellation/restart, multi-step task-agent continuation, plugin/MCP gateway permission behavior, and browser capability lifecycle. A private replacement harness would duplicate N.E.K.O's own runtime tests.

decision.implementation_boundary: Select and run existing pinned N.E.K.O tests in the ordinary agent/** product gate. Do not create a XiaoYu task runner, fake capability gateway, second permission harness, browser driver, or alternate runtime.
decision.browser_rule: Prefer N.E.K.O's existing real-browser suite. The gate may claim real-browser coverage only if launcher.find_browsers() finds an installed supported browser and the selected tests actually run; skip is not acceptance.

reuse_order.reason: The pin already contains executable tests using the real Ledger/Host/Gateway/runtime tools and temp filesystem/process/browser fixtures.
Upstream main resolves to the same c3fc33ff commit; no newer product-E2E seam supersedes the pinned tests.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / NekoClaw / MCP / native browser
reuse_order.reason: The existing tests exercise those exact native capability, permission and lifecycle paths rather than a XiaoYu substitute.
This unit validates N.E.K.O execution behavior; external surface components do not own filesystem/shell/task-agent/MCP/browser execution.
pytest/pytest-asyncio and the native fixtures already exist; another runner would add indirection without improving authority fidelity.
A workflow selection of native tests is sufficient. No helper daemon/router/store/runtime is needed.
No native runtime acceptance gap has been reproduced by this review.

acceptance_rules: ordinary agent/** push runs the selected native tests after pinned N.E.K.O checkout
no test is copied into XiaoYu; test node ids point directly at pinned N.E.K.O
failure of a selected native test fails the product gate
real-browser acceptance requires an installed supported browser and non-skipped selected real-browser tests
no credentials or user accounts are required
no Agent master, dsh installation, permission mutation or external side effect is enabled by this acceptance unit
retirement_condition: Retire the overlay test-selection step when the pinned N.E.K.O upstream CI itself exposes an equivalent required product-level execution E2E suite and XiaoYu can invoke that upstream suite directly without losing coverage.
